title: Neighborhood Access Grant Starting Amount by Census Tract Income Level
content:
**Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant — starting amount by census tract**

The starting amount of the grant award follows the census tract income level of the property, as recorded on the borrower's Mortgage Loan File:

| Census tract income level of the property | Starting amount of the grant award |
|---|---|
| moderate | 4900.00 |
| middle or upper (the grant is then qualified on income alone) | 4750.00 |
| low | the program's fixed credit amount |

### Clause

A property in a moderate-income tract starts at 4900.00; a property in a middle-income or upper-income tract, where the grant is qualified on income alone, starts at 4750.00; a property in a low-income tract starts at the program's fixed credit amount, the figure the Closing Cost Credit award schedule gives the Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant.

### Cases (hypothetical files)

| Tract level on the Mortgage Loan File | Starting amount |
|---|---|
| moderate | 4900.00 |
| middle | 4750.00 |
| upper | 4750.00 |
| low | the program's fixed credit amount |
